chains.label: miniDSP UMIK-1 → CoreAudio → vj-capture WAV 48k/24
chains.notes: era.start is set by the first real session. Before first capture: download the per-serial calibration file from miniDSP into calFile's path, set the UMIK as the input device, set the input-volume slider once, then `npm run capture -- pin-volume --chain umik1`. Re-pinning later is a logged era event, not a casual act.
